card.name: Gurdjieff movements
card.tagline: Esoteric 'sacred dances' devised by G. I. Gurdjieff — NOT Chinese
card.profile: The Gurdjieff movements are a series of sacred dances created by mystic G. I. Gurdjieff (c.1866–1949) and taught to pupils to facilitate self-observation and self-study (English Wikipedia). Drawing on traditional dances Gurdjieff said he encountered in Central Asia, India, Tibet and among Sufi orders, the movements use precise, mathematically constructed postures and rhythms. Per English Wikipedia, 'Gurdjieff created and taught around fifty different movements between 1918 to when he died in Paris in 1949.'
card.insight: They represent a unique 20th-century attempt to treat dance as 'objective art' encoding esoteric knowledge, and remain central to Gurdjieffian 'Fourth Way' practice (English Wikipedia; Gurdjieff studies).
